stem: Based on the excerpt, which statement explains Thomas Jefferson’s view on religious freedom in the colonies?

options.label: A
options.text: Religious freedom was already protected by the colonies.

options.label: B
options.text: Although colonists left England to escape religious persecution, religious freedom was restricted by some colonies.

options.label: C
options.text: Due to religious persecution in England, religious freedom was valued above all other rights in the colonies.

options.label: D
options.text: Religious freedom was considered unimportant by the colonies.

visual_elements: The poor Quakers were [fleeing] from persecution in England. They cast their eyes on these new [colonies for] religious freedom. . . . Several acts of the Virginia assembly of 1659, 1662 and 1693 . . . had prohibited the unlawful assembling of Quakers: had made it [illegal] for any [ship] to bring a Quaker into the state. —Thomas Jefferson, Notes on the State of Virginia, 1801
